$comment: The D1 edge table with §7.1 verb classes, as data. Every legal transition appears exactly once and carries exactly one class. Worker rows require the current claim token (requires_token) except claim, which mints it. Effects are the shim-written side effects defined in §7.1/D1: there is no free-form field-set verb.

effect_vocabulary.mint_token: issue a fresh claim token and write the card's claim block
effect_vocabulary.set_lease: set lease_expires from --lease (default from config); leases apply only to in_progress
effect_vocabulary.end_claim: clear the card's claim block and lease
effect_vocabulary.write_handoff: write the machine-generated handoff stub to handoff/<task-id>.md on the state ref
effect_vocabulary.record_review: write the card's review block (reviewer identity, timestamp, evidence reference)
effect_vocabulary.append_rejected_author: append the rejected implementer to rejected_authors
effect_vocabulary.cascade: blocker-cascade: remove dep:<this-id> from every card's blocked_on; each card whose set empties transitions blocked→ready via the dep_cascade auto-path
effect_vocabulary.add_blocked_on: add the entry named by the verb's arguments to blocked_on (plan:<pr> | dep:<task-id> | manual:<operator>)
effect_vocabulary.remove_blocked_on_manual: remove this operator's manual: entry from blocked_on

transitions.notes: Token-minting bootstrap exception (§7.1): presents no token. Synchronous: the claim commit is pushed inside the verb; push rejection re-fetches and re-checks. A claim on an unplanned card authorizes planning only.
Manual blocking of unclaimed cards only (§7.1).

operator_overrides.name: reap
operator_overrides.notes: Maintenance reap (§7.1): a release, not a rejection: rejected_authors untouched. Legal only when the lease is expired.

transitions.notes: Plan parking (D1) uses this edge with a plan:<pr> entry, strictly PR-first.
Operator cancel clears the live claim and lease as a defined side effect (§7.1).

auto_paths.name: dep_cascade
auto_paths.trigger: close or cancel of the blocking task

auto_paths.name: plan_unblock
auto_paths.trigger: maintenance observes the plan PR merged or closed (state-shaped, not event-shaped)

transitions.notes: Each path removes only its own blocked_on entry; the transition fires only when the set empties. Auto-paths run shim-mediated under an operator credential.

close.notes: close = accept + blocker-cascade, valid only from review (any other state is exit 3). Normative sequence: server PR approval → merge → close (§7.1).

release.notes: Convenience name for the worker release edge in_progress→ready.

comment.notes: Fenced while the card holds a claim; unfenced on unclaimed cards.

attach-evidence.notes: Append-only. Fenced while the card holds a claim.

lease-renew.notes: Required capability of the filecards backend; loop runner renews at half-lease cadence.
